name: obsidian-tasks-calendar
description: A calendar view for tasks in an Obsidian vault.

scripts.build: npm run check && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Obsidian Tasks Calendar contributors
